targets.name: reset and idle contract
targets.coverage_definition: Exercise reset assertion, release, and an idle observation window
targets.sampling_rule: Sample control and output signals at reset, first released cycle, and stable idle
targets.oracle_definition: The public interface matches the frozen reset/idle contract

targets.name: transaction acceptance
targets.coverage_definition: Exercise an idle load that samples one key/text pair and starts encryption
targets.sampling_rule: Sample ld, key, text_in, and the first active-cycle state
targets.oracle_definition: Exactly one transaction is accepted under the documented load rule

targets.name: busy input isolation
targets.coverage_definition: Toggle key/text and attempt load while an operation is active
targets.sampling_rule: Sample the active transaction before and after each busy-cycle disturbance
targets.oracle_definition: Behavior matches the frozen busy/reload contract without corrupting the active operation

targets.name: completion latency
targets.coverage_definition: Observe accepted load through the specified completion cycle
targets.sampling_rule: Sample done and cycle count on every active cycle
targets.oracle_definition: done assertion and latency match the frozen transaction contract

targets.name: AES-128 known-answer encryption
targets.coverage_definition: Exercise the frozen FIPS-197 known-answer vectors
targets.sampling_rule: Sample ciphertext only in the contract-defined valid output window
targets.oracle_definition: text_out equals the corresponding AES-128 reference ciphertext

targets.name: key and state byte mapping
targets.coverage_definition: Exercise sparse and asymmetric vectors that distinguish byte-order mappings
targets.sampling_rule: Sample the accepted input vector and final ciphertext for every mapping pattern
targets.oracle_definition: Ciphertext matches the FIPS-197 state and key byte ordering

targets.name: output validity and hold window
targets.coverage_definition: Observe text_out before, at, and after done
targets.sampling_rule: Sample text_out across the complete frozen output-validity window
targets.oracle_definition: Output validity and stability match the interface contract

targets.name: back-to-back transactions
targets.coverage_definition: Exercise two adjacent accepted transactions with distinct key/text pairs
targets.sampling_rule: Sample acceptance and ciphertext identity for both transactions
targets.oracle_definition: Each output belongs to its corresponding accepted transaction

targets.name: initial, middle, and final round boundaries
targets.coverage_definition: Exercise a transaction across the initial AddRoundKey, middle rounds, and final round
targets.sampling_rule: Sample common observable boundary indicators or approved reference checkpoints
targets.oracle_definition: Boundary ordering and final-round behavior match AES-128
